name: Pair of K16 turbochargers of the 993 Turbo (PicoGK display concept)
picogk_enhancement: Each block-and-cylinder unit becomes a recognisable turbocharger: compressor inlet with hose bead, spiral volutes with tangential discharge and tangential flanged turbine inlet, centre housing with oil feed boss and drain pad, heat shield, axial outlet with three-ear flange, integral wastegate boss and actuator can, hollow open gas paths and simplified wheels in both bores; the two mirrored units are joined by a schematic discharge crossover so the pair is one display body.

unit_length_mm.note: FVD product envelope per turbo 280 x 190 x 210 mm (right-hand 99312301452; left-hand page states the same)

unit_width_mm.note: FVD product envelope per turbo; sets the compressor volute outer diameter

pair_spacing_mm.note: left-right centre distance supposed (legacy concept hypothesis)

turbine_volute_outer_radius_mm.note: turbine volute outer radius (legacy concept turbine cylinder radius 85 mm)

compressor_inlet_bore_diameter_mm.note: inlet bore ahead of the 40.6 mm inducer; not measured

turbine_outlet_bore_diameter_mm.note: outlet bore behind the 48.97 mm exducer; not measured

crossover_pipe_od_mm.note: schematic compressor-discharge crossover; real 993 routing not modelled

crossover_axis_height_mm.note: schematic crossover height above the turbo axis

open_interfaces: all flanges, fasteners, V-band / clamp geometry, oil and coolant ports
true volute A/R, tongue and clocking (declared A/R and clocking in the record are not modelled)
left/right units are mirrored here; the real units differ (6735 right, 6736 left)
discharge crossover / intercooler routing is schematic
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
